title: CampaignState
description: Authoritative campaign state version 9: phase 15 player destruction, loss records, insurance settlement, recovery grants and wreck bookmarks (Technical Specification 8-11).

createdAtRealMs.description: Display only. Excluded from the authoritative state hash.

activeShipId.description: The ship the player controls, or null while a docked pilot owns none at that station (Functional Specification 9.12).

lastDockedStationId.description: The most recently docked station: where a destroyed pilot is recovered and where a retreat heads.

condition.description: Hit points lost per layer and the current capacitor charge.

recoveryGrant.description: Supplied by the recovery service: no sale or insurance value (Functional Specification 9.12).

state.description: What the units are doing: stored, fitted in a slot, or loaded as a charge.

recoveryGrant.description: Recovery-grant units: usable, never saleable or insurable. The mark travels with the units (Functional Specification 9.12; Technical Specification 8.3).

selectedBookmarkId.description: The player's own wreck chosen at the station instead of an encounter; at most one of the two is set (Functional Specification 5.4, 9.12).

movementOrders.description: Standing movement order of each ship in the loaded site, keyed by entity id.

fitting.description: The open fitting draft, or null when the player has none (Functional Specification 8.4).

combat.description: Locks, weapon cycles and reloads by ship entity id (Functional Specification 9.2, 9.4).

recovery.description: The last loss and how the player was recovered from it (Functional Specification 9.12).

onboarding.description: Progress through the contextual guidance: completed or skipped steps and whether it is hidden (Functional Specification 3.2; MVP Scope 6). A step is recorded once, so a replayed event cannot complete it twice.

notifications.description: The bounded, grouped history of semantic notifications, which is also the event log, and the once-per-site notifications already raised in the current site visit (Functional Specification 19.7, 20; Technical Specification 12.4, 13).

bookmarkId.description: The bookmark the warp is aimed at, or null for a warp to the site itself.

anchor.description: The site-local point the warp arrives relative to.

layerDamage.description: Hit points removed, by the defense layer they came off.

owner.description: Whose ship it was. The player's own wreck is an automatic bookmark (Functional Specification 5.4, 9.12).

lossRecord.description: What a player destruction left behind, frozen when it committed (Functional Specification 9.12; Technical Specification 10.9). The lost ship and its wreck may since be gone.

incoming.description: Attackers in the order they first hit the ship.

lossDamageSource.description: One attacker's share of the damage the lost ship took. lastAtMs is never before firstAtMs.

lossFinalDamage.description: The last burst of fire the ship took before its hull gave out.

lossItem.description: Units the lost ship carried and whether they survived into the wreck. Loaded ammunition never survives.

lossInsurance.description: The settlement. Enhanced cover is consumed by the loss it pays for; a recovery-grant hull pays nothing.

lossRecovery.description: How the pilot was left able to fly again. Only a pilot left without a ship has no active ship.
